data.name: Nujum
data.gender_notes: Nujum is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nujum means Stars in Arabic. The name Nujum carries the meaning “Stars” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nujum usually hope their child will grow to embody stars and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nujum represents the divine guidance and protection of Allah, symbolized by the stars in the night sky.
data.etymology: Nujum belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Stars.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nujum total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نجوم
in_arabic.meaning: النجوم تعني النجوم في السماء وهي جمع نجم
in_arabic.long_meaning: النجوم هو اسم جمع مشتق من نجم، ويعني النجوم في السماء. في القرآن الكريم، ذكرت كلمة النجوم في عدة آيات، مثل 'وَالنُجُومِ وَالشَجَرِ يَسْجُدَانِ' (الرحمن: 6). النجوم هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الإضاءة والهداية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نجوم
in_urdu.meaning: نجوم آسمان میں ستاروں کو کہتے ہیں، جمع ہے نجم کی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نجوم ایک جمع اسم ہے جو نجم سے ماخوذ ہے، اور آسمان میں ستاروں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے اخذ کردہ، اس کا مطلب ہے روشنی اور ہدایت کی علامت۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں، نجوم ایک ایسا نام ہے جو روشن مستقبل کی امید کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नजूम
in_hindi.meaning: नजूम आकाश में तारों को कहते हैं, नجم की جمع
in_hindi.long_meaning: नजूम एक संज्ञा है जो नجم से व्युत्पन्न है, और आकाश में तारों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, नجوم नाम का अर्थ है प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन का प्रतीक। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बच्चे के लिए एक उज्ज्वल भविष्य की कामना के रूप में चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نجوم
in_pashto.meaning: نجوم د آسمان ستوري دي، د نجم جمع
in_pashto.long_meaning: نجوم د نجم څخه اخیستل شوی جمع اسم دی، چې د آسمان ستورو لپاره کارول کیږي. د افغان او پښتني دودیزو ارزښو له مخې، نجوم یو داسې نوم دی چې د روښان او هدایت کونکي معنی څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Nujum
in_english.meaning: Nujum means stars in the sky, a symbol of guidance and light
in_english.long_meaning: Nujum is a name derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-m', meaning stars in the sky. Referenced in the Quran (Ar-Rahman: 6), stars symbolize guidance, wisdom, and illumination. Historically, Nujum has been used across Islamic cultures to signify a bright and enlightened future. The name embodies qualities of hope, inspiration, and spiritual guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nujum holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. Stars have been a subject of fascination for human beings since the beginning of time. They have served as navigational tools, calendars, and sources of inspiration in many cultures. In Islamic tradition, stars hold a special place in astronomical sciences as well as in spiritual belief systems.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Nujum holds a profound significance. It is a reminder of the infinite greatness and majesty of Allah, the Creator of the universe and all its wonders, including the stars. Stars serve as a constant reminder of Allah's presence, power, and wisdom. As stated in the Quran, "Blessed is He in Whose hand is the dominion, and He over all things hath power. He created death and life, that He might test you, which of you is best in deed" (Quran 67:2).
